morphology.compounding_rule: Sinitic feature/quality + type juxtaposition ([surname]+[given]; Jin-cheng golden-city, Bei-guan north-pass) layered over Nahua place-compounds re-cut to Sinitic shape (Huei-tepe great-mountain, Quetz-tlan feather-place): the capital Huaztlan (Hua-ztlan, the cathay-of-the-jungle, the dragon-serpent river-land), Da-teomiao (the great sun-pyramid temple), Jin-cheng (the golden city).
morphology.patronymic_form: the Sinitic mandarin nobility carry the clan-surname (xing) first then a given name, with generation-names within a zu (lineage) and an examination-rank; the Nahua substrate keep the calpolli (ward) name and a calendar-day name with -tzin reverential for the honored; the throne fuses both - a Huangdi who carries a Sinitic xing and holds the Mandate over the teocalli-cities and the calpolli wards.

patterns.dungeons_ruins: fallen warlord cheng and drowned teomiao-pyramids: 'the Sunken Teomiao of [name]', 'the Ruined Cheng of [warlord]', 'the lost Altepetl of [tlatoani]'
patterns.military_units: the [general] Ying (camp/army) / the [color] Banner over the Nahua warrior-societies: 'the Tiger Ying', 'the Azure Banner', 'the Jaguar Knights (Ocelotl)', 'the Eagle Knights (Cuauhtli)'
patterns.ships: river-junk and lake-canoe (acalli) names: 'the Jade Dragon', 'the Quetzal of Huaztlan', 'the Heaven-Mandate', 'the Feathered Serpent'
patterns.taverns: 'The [Adjective] [Noun]': 'The Jade Cup', 'The Plum-and-Cacao House', 'The Octli-and-Tea Court'

religion._note: Deity-names are morphs of the Agrippan canon - Sinitic canon-morphs PRIMARY (the Jinxian / family_east_asian theonym_sets.sinitic: Tuli-di, Aolan-jun, Gaidun-di, Numeng-jun, Lianta-mu), Nahuatl morphs SECONDARY (the Nahuan / family_mesoamerican theonym_sets.nahuatl: Tolratl, Marakatl, Gaiantli, Numenatl, Rialtzin), recognizably the same powers under two faces, never real Chinese/Aztec gods (no Tian-shang-di, Guan-yu, Quetzalcoatl, Tezcatlipoca, Huitzilopochtli). Shared pantheon, two registers married. A Celestial Bureaucracy under the Mandate of Heaven laid over the calendar-round: the One (Aiteng, the Nahua face Aiternatl) presides as Highest Heaven; the Lawful powers are the celestial officials (the -di emperors and -jun lords of the dragon-court); the jungle war-cult of the substrate leans to the Chaotic blood-sun (Marakatl). The Mandate (Tianming) legitimizes the throne, the calendar-round and the offered heart bind the calpolli wards. Worship vs demonization follows the culture's CURRENT alignment (see worship_by_alignment).

clergy_ladder.9: Tianshi (celestial master) / Hueyi Teopixqui (Nahua great sacrificer)

religion.demon_epithet_pattern: the Chaotic powers, warded by the dragon-court as the demon-marshals (mo) outside the celestial order or as the Nahua tzitzimitl star-demons, keep their morphs + an epithet: Maraxus -> Maluo the War-Fire Marshal (Nahua Marakatl the Blood-Sun); Vacidus -> Wuci the Devourer (Nahua Wakitl the Hungering-Dark); Lusanto -> Lusan the Coin-Serpent (Nahua Lusankoatl the Hoard-Serpent).

holy_symbol_motifs.Gaidun-di: a green mountain over the grain-altar and the chinampa-field
holy_symbol_motifs.Maluo: an obsidian knife over a blood-fed sun, wreathed in dragon-fire
holy_symbol_motifs.Tuli-di: a red sun-disc above the scales and seal of office, ringed by the feathered serpent

religion.religious_orders_pattern: the Miao (Sinitic temple) or the Teomiao (the sun-pyramid god-house atop the great pyramid) of [power]: 'the Miao of Tuli-di', 'the Teomiao of Maluo', crowned by the skull-rack; the ancestral Ci (clan-shrine) for the zu.
religion.saints_pattern: deified worthy officials and heroes enrolled in the celestial register, honored at the Ci (ancestral shrine) and the Miao; and the fallen jaguar-and-eagle warriors and offered captives who become sun-feeding companions, honored at the teomiao and the skull-rack.

sample_deity_renames.Maraxus: Maluo (Nahua Marakatl) - the War-Fire Marshal, the Blood-Sun of the jaguar-cult; chief of the Chaotic powers
sample_deity_renames.Numeno: Numeng-jun (Nahua Numenatl) - the Sage Lord of the winds, the feathered-serpent wind
sample_deity_renames.Orlandus: Aolan-jun (Nahua Orlantzin) - the iron Lord of oath and war

religion.the_one: Aiteng (< Aeternus; the Nahua face Aiternatl) - the Highest Heaven, the source of the Mandate, served not petitioned by the dragon-court; named the Tyrant-Sun by the Chaotic jaguar-cult of the substrate

worship_by_alignment.Chaotic: Venerates the Chaotic powers of the canon - chief among them Maluo / Marakatl, the War-Fire, the Blood-Sun that must be fed by the offered heart - and names the One (Aiteng) and the Lawful powers the cold tyrant-gods of the soft; the jaguar war-cult and the skull-rack atop the teomiao the altars, the calendar-round binding the wards to the blood-sun.
worship_by_alignment.Lawful: venerates the Lawful powers - Aiteng the Highest Heaven, Tuli-di the just Sun-Emperor, Aolan-jun of the sworn war, Lianta-mu the merciful - keeps the Confucian rites and the Mandate of Heaven, and names the Chaotic powers the demon-marshals (mo / Nahua tzitzimitl), warded; the dragon-throne and the celestial register bind the realm.
worship_by_alignment.Neutral: honors the zu-ancestors (the deified worthy officials of the celestial register) and the Nahua calpolli fore-spirits, and the local earth-and-grain, river and mountain powers; the great powers invoked at the teomiao-pyramid and the ancestral Ci situationally; the calendar-round and the harvest kept.

titles._tiers_note: Sinitic ladder, ascending, with the Nahua pyramid-city substrate co-titles beneath. Nan (baron) barony; Dudu (frontier military command) march; Bo (count) county; Hou (marquis) duchy; Gong (duke / prince of the blood) principality; Wang (king) kingdom over a Wangguo; Huangdi (emperor) empire over the Diguo, holding the Mandate of Heaven (Tianming). The conquered jungle-cities keep their Nahua tlatoani (city-king of an altepetl), tecuhtli (lord) and the calpolli ward-heads beneath the Sinitic crown; the Confucian mandarin shi-officials govern, the Nahua tlamacazqui jaguar-priests tend the teocalli, both standing in and beside the ladder. NO approved foreign term applies (neither the Sinitic nor the Nahua ranks are on the approved commonly-known list), so ALL display rulers are plain English; the Sinitic *_native forms are for NPC DIALOGUE ONLY.
titles.display_policy: Ruler/domain titles shown in setting-gen, domain lists and vassal trees are plain ENGLISH - NO approved foreign term applies here (neither the Sinitic nor the Nahua ranks are on the approved commonly-known list), so there is no foreign display term and approved_foreign_terms_used is omitted. The *_native conlang forms (Sinitic, with Nahua co-titles) are for NPC DIALOGUE ONLY, never for structural/UI displays.
titles.government: feudal (a Sinitic celestial-court over the Nahua pyramid-cities: the Huangdi and his wang-kin at the crown holding the Mandate, the peerage-governors over the cheng-provinces, the Confucian mandarin order of officials; the Nahua tlatoque city-kings, the pipiltin nobility, the calpolli wards and the jaguar war-cult serve beneath)
titles.heir: Taizi (the crown prince; the heir) / Shizi (heir of a wang or peer)
